title: Volume 1 Chapter 2: Class Five
content: I was walking down the hallway of the school building with Dr. Alison from early morning.
Our destination was the classroom where my assigned unit would receive training.
It seemed that all the active Valkyries were female students, and they attended classes just like regular students when not on missions, training, or in standby mode.
Dr. Alison was wearing a lab coat over her casual clothes, walking with her hands in her pockets while conveying necessary information.
"We have a little time until the equipment arrives. If Dr. Smith is satisfied with the adjustments, it should come along with it," she said.
There was a hint of sharpness in Dr. Alison's words regarding Dr. Smith.

"Until Dr. Smith and the experimental equipment arrive, you'll be going through the training regimen. You'll also need to respond to Principal Kase's requests. It would be a disaster if she got upset, considering she’s the base commander."
As Dr. Alison said this, she turned her gaze toward the window.
Even though classes hadn’t started yet, the female students were already changing into their gym clothes and training hard on the field.
However, it was still different from a typical military base.
The training wear they were wearing consisted of shorts and sleeveless tops.
Noticing that I was watching the scene on the field, Dr. Alison asked me, a smile inexplicably on her face.
"You seem quite interested, stopping to stare like that."
As Dr. Alison pointed out, I was indeed curious.
"Yes. Since it’s not training time right now, I assume they are engaging in voluntary training. This is proof of the high morale at this base."
As I was impressed by the Valkyrie base, Dr. Alison let out a big sigh.
"I want to confirm something... do you know about club activities? Have you heard of morning practice?"
"I’m aware of it. ...Could it be that they are not training but rather in morning practice for their club activities?"
"Yes, that’s right."
Dr. Alison affirmed with a tired expression.
I remembered hearing my comrades talk about club activities in my previous unit.
Since I had never experienced club activities myself, I couldn’t join the conversation, but I was impressed that I could see the real thing at this base.
"This is my first time seeing it."
"That’s good to hear."
"Yes."
As Dr. Alison began walking again, I followed her.
In the hallway where the voices of the female students in morning practice could be heard, Dr. Alison spoke about the unit I would be assigned to—Class Five.
"Now, let me tell you about the upcoming schedule. You’ll be joining Class Five... think of it as a class that consolidates reserve forces made up of Valkyries who have graduated from middle school."
"Reserve forces?"

"There’s a limit to the number of Valkyrie dresses available for the Valkyries. The trainees who have undergone three years of training in middle school are not considered true Valkyries even after graduating. They must be scouted into the regular units from Class One to Class Four to become real Valkyries."
"What happens if they are not chosen?"

"They graduate after three years of enrollment. However, once they graduate from middle school, they are considered elites. There are many jobs within the organization that only they can hold, so they shouldn’t have any trouble making a living."
While I had only noticed their glorious achievements, it seemed that the Valkyries I had seen on the battlefield were elite who had triumphed in fierce competition.
"I didn’t know there were such circumstances."
"It’s not something that’s publicly stated, so be careful not to leak it. However, those who know are aware, so it’s not exactly a secret."
Looking out the window, I saw the female students smiling and sweating as they trained from early morning.
The classroom for Class Five was tiered, and there were many female students enrolled.
All of them were girls up to eighteen years old, and they turned their gazes toward me as I stood in front of the whiteboard.
"I will be joining this unit starting today. I am Corporal Ichinose Ren!"
I shouted my voice to echo through the classroom and saluted.
The instructor for Class Five, standing next to me, had a rather sour expression that didn’t seem welcoming at all.
A former Valkyrie, she was now nurturing the next generation as an instructor.
"You’re quite energetic this morning, Ichinose."
"Yes! I put in my best effort for my greeting upon joining!"
When I responded in a relaxed posture, a crease formed between the instructor's brows.
"That was meant to be a jab, but it seems you didn’t pick up on it, which makes me sad."
"My apologies!"
"…This is technically a military base on paper, but let’s refrain from military-style behavior. We treat them as students. Here, you should adapt to us."
"Understood!"
Though I was raising my voice because the classroom was large, the instructor looked annoyed.
When I glanced at the female students, none of their gazes were particularly friendly.
Most of them were wary, and some even directed hostility toward me.
Their attitudes spoke volumes about me being an outsider at this base.
However—
"Now then, let’s decide on your seat—"
As the instructor scanned the classroom to determine my seat, one female student raised her right hand high.
"Yes, teacher! The seat next to me is open! Here, here! The seat to the right of Louise is available!"
──A silver-haired female student cheerfully and curiously pointed out my seat.
After surveying the classroom, the instructor told me with a look of annoyance, "Then go sit next to Louise."
"Yes!"
I quickly moved to take my seat, and the girl to my left began talking to me.
"We're in the same class starting today. I’m Louise Duran. Ichinose Ren? Or just Ren? Which do you prefer?"
With a curious expression, she leaned in closer.
"I’ve heard that everyone in Class Five is a corporal. Since you all have seniority, feel free to call me however you like."
"Then it’s Ren-kun! Just call me Louise. This is an order from your senior. You mustn’t go against it!"
[img]https://i.imgur.com/G4BCv13.jpeg

While it was true that Corporal Louise had seniority, I couldn’t follow an order like that. We were both corporals. If the instructor said so, it would be fine, but considering the chain of command, I couldn’t accept this order.
However, this was both a military base and a school.
There might be rules within the school, and ignoring them would be a poor move for building smooth relationships in the future.
The question was whether this was an official rule within the school.
"…An order, you say?"
As I pondered, it seemed that Corporal Louise began to fluster.
"Is that a no? Then how about a request instead?"
With a somewhat timid attitude, Corporal Louise asked, but a request posed no problem.
"If it’s a request, then that’s fine. You can call me however you like as well."
The worried look on Louise’s face transformed into a beaming smile.
"Then we’re friends starting today! Nice to meet you, Ren-kun!"
"I may cause you trouble since I’m not familiar with this base, but I look forward to your guidance."
"You’re so stiff. Come on, Ren-kun, let’s talk more like friends!"
"More like friends, you say? …I’ll do my best."
As I conversed with Louise, the instructor interrupted us.
"Have you finished your greetings? Then that’s the end of homeroom. Check your devices for any announcements. That’s all."
The first class was about the conduct of Valkyries on the battlefield.
The instructor stood in front of the whiteboard, operating a device to use the monitor for explanations.
"What I’m going to teach you now is how to deal with falling on the battlefield."
The class explained the actions to take if one fell to the ground during a battle.
"If you fall to the ground during an emergency on the battlefield, we will immediately dispatch a rescue team."
The footage displayed was of an infantry unit engaged in combat on the ground.
From the scale and equipment of the unit, it was clear that the footage featured an elite squad.
It was rare for an elite squad to be dispatched, as most often, nearby units would be sent.
The instructor glanced my way but quickly returned to the lesson.

"Once you’re picked up by the rescue team, you must immediately begin moving. No idle chit-chat with the infantry is allowed. If spoken to, do not engage in small talk at all. If necessary, be cold. Act with only one thought in mind: to retreat from the battlefield as quickly as possible without showing any sentiment."
Louise, sitting next to me, was timidly raising her hand while glancing my way.
The instructor called on Louise.
"What is it, Louise?"
"Is there really a point in being cold after being rescued? I think it’s better to at least say thank you."
Since the others seemed to know my background, their gazes were more focused on me than on Louise, who had asked the question.
The instructor looked at me but returned her gaze to the device.

"Even if you’re a Valkyrie, if you don’t have a Valkyrie dress, you could lose your life against a Rank Three Gijuu. Especially if it’s the infantry, who are the main force on the ground. If you want to waste time for your own satisfaction in that situation, and a few seconds of delay could cost you your life, then feel free. However, personally, I hope there’s no fool in this classroom who would let infantry die just for their own satisfaction."
I agreed with the idea of retreating as quickly as possible.
However, I couldn’t understand the intent behind being cold.
If someone came to rescue you at the risk of their life, being cold would likely diminish the infantry's willingness to help.
It seemed that Louise was concerned about me, as she spoke up to the instructor.
"In that case, I don’t think it’s necessary to be cold."
The instructor, with a troubled expression, began explaining the circumstances that led to the current manual.

"There have been many cases in the past where people mistook a fateful encounter for a crisis situation. Valkyries who were still active kept graduating one after another. The organization invests a considerable budget into training each Valkyrie. If they easily graduate due to misunderstandings, it wouldn’t be worth it, would it?"
If a comic or hair stylist heard this, they would likely be thrilled. It was indeed a significant loss for the organization if even one elite Valkyrie left.
If they were calculating on the assumption that they would continue fighting as active forces, a fateful encounter leading to retirement would surely trouble the organization.
A battlefield romance? It would be unacceptable for plans to be disrupted because of that.
Another female student, different from Louise, raised her hand to speak.
"If it really was a fateful encounter, would that be allowed? I don’t think it matters if you fall in love."
Her laughing question seemed to be intended to trouble the instructor.
The instructor responded.

"Currently, if a relationship is established, an investigation is initiated, and the infantry side is severely punished. The Valkyries are not held accountable because the organization values you more than a single infantryman. So—while the infantry who risked their lives to save you face unreasonable consequences, do you want to say that you would accept this based on a fleeting emotion?"
As the female students fell silent, the instructor continued.

"The organization invests a huge budget to nurture you. This is because you are valuable forces capable of fighting against Rank Two Gijuu and above, as well as being the guardians of the world. I hope you won’t throw everything away due to a momentary lapse in judgment."
I had rescued fallen Valkyries a few times in the past.
During those times, all of them had treated us infantry with cold attitudes.
I never expected to hear the reason for that here.
The instructor turned her gaze toward me.
"Now then, let’s hear from Ichinose, who has actually been an infantryman. What was the attitude of the Valkyries you rescued?"
"All the Valkyries I rescued built walls against the infantry. …May I ask a question?"
"What is it?"
"I hadn’t heard that infantry would be punished for having relationships with Valkyries. There shouldn’t have been any formal notification."
Why hadn’t the infantry been informed? The instructor answered my question.
"It would be troublesome if they were known and took clever measures. It’s easier to catch those who are elated about being able to date Valkyries… that’s all."
For a moment, I pictured the face of the hair stylist.
If it were the hair stylist, they would likely be overjoyed to be dating a Valkyrie and would quickly let their guard down.
After school.
Once class was over, the female students of Class Five packed their belongings and left the classroom in a flurry.
"What are you doing after school?"
"I might want to save money since it’s before payday."
"I can’t wait for payday to come."
It seemed that after school was free time, and my unit—my classmates were spending it as they pleased.
I also packed my things, intending to return to the storage room to go through today’s training regimen.
As I was about to leave the classroom, Louise stood up and approached me.
"Are you going to join the development team now, Ren-kun?"
"Yes."
However, at the moment, there was no particular reason for me to be there.
I would merely go through the training regimen aimed at maintaining my best condition as a pilot.
I kept my explanation brief to avoid touching on any confidential matters.
When I answered succinctly, Louise made a suggestion.
"You seem to have a lot on your plate, Ren-kun. Personally, I’d like to show you around the academy!"
With a voice that sounded somewhat sweet, Louise's suggestion prompted me to respond in a businesslike manner.
"I am already aware of the locations of the facilities I will be using and entering."
It seemed Louise took my response as dismissive.
With her hands on her hips, she leaned forward and got closer to my face.
"No, no. That’s not good at all."
"Not good, you say?"
Louise pressed closer, mixing in some French, and I leaned back to create distance. It seemed she didn’t appreciate my attitude, as she moved in even closer.
She propped her knees on the desk and leaned in more aggressively.
Though we had only just met, I couldn’t shake the feeling that she was being quite forceful in her invitation.
"Since a girl is mustering up the courage to invite you, I think there’s a way to say no even if you’re going to decline."
Remembering the mission from Principal Kase to get along with the female students, I suddenly realized I needed to create some distance from Louise and straighten my posture.
It seemed my current answer was not well-received.
"I was being shallow."
Upon reflection, it was indeed rude to turn down an offer from Corporal Louise, who was extending her goodwill by offering to show me around the base.
Louise was smiling wryly at my attitude.
"You’re really stiff, Ren-kun. That’s one of your good points, I guess… So, will you accompany me?"
With a tilt of her head and a smile, I nodded in acceptance of Louise’s proposal.
"I look forward to it."
